stories.title: Sweep Reaction — Gausman Gets Shelled in Milwaukee
stories.angle: Gausman allowed 3 HRs (Yelich 3-run, Chourio solo, Contreras solo) in 4 IP as Brewers completed the sweep. Cubs rallied with 5 in the 9th (Conforto 2-run double) but fell short. Gausman now 9-12.

x_posts.label: Post 1A
x_posts.text:
Three home runs. Four innings. Gausman got shelled.

Yelich, Chourio, Contreras took him deep. Cubs rallied with five in the ninth — too little, too late. The Brewers complete the sweep.

Wrigley next. Pirates tomorrow. Time to reset.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: NL Wild Card Standing — Cubs Still Hold WC2
stories.angle: Despite the sweep, Cubs remain NL WC2, 0.5 GB behind the Phillies. Padres WC3, D-backs on the bubble. Cubs 99%+ playoff probability. 15 games to lock home-field in Wild Card round.

x_posts.label: Post 2A
x_posts.text:
The sweep stings. But the Cubs still hold a playoff spot.

NL Wild Card 2 — 0.5 games behind the Phillies. Padres and D-backs fighting for the third seed. Fifteen games to lock up home-field.

The work starts again tomorrow at Wrigley.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: PCA 40-40 Watch — 41 HR / 35 SB
stories.angle: PCA at 41 HR / 35 SB. Needs 5 more SBs in 15 games to join one of the most exclusive clubs in baseball. No Cub has ever reached 40-40. Off day — stats unchanged, milestone clock still ticking.

x_posts.label: Post 3A
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong: 41 HR / 35 SB.

Five stolen bases. Fifteen games. That's what stands between PCA and one of the rarest achievements in baseball history.

Only a handful of players have ever done 40-40. No Cub has. He's knocking.

#Cubs #GoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Wiggins + Steele — Bullpen Reinforcements En Route
stories.angle: Jaxon Wiggins has 8 scoreless Iowa bullpen innings since Aug. 11 (10 K), making his September callup feel overdue. Justin Steele (TJ recovery) has completed 2 Iowa rehab outings and is targeting an October bullpen role.

x_posts.label: Post 4A
x_posts.text:
The bullpen needs help. It's coming.

Jaxon Wiggins: 8 scoreless Iowa bullpen innings since Aug. 11. Callup feels inevitable.

Justin Steele: two Iowa outings in, targeting an October return from TJ surgery.

Reinforcements are on the way.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Pirates Series Preview — Wrigley Homestand Starts Tomorrow
stories.angle: Cubs host the Pittsburgh Pirates (below .500) for 3 games at Wrigley Field starting Sept 11 (1:20 PM CT). A mandatory bounce-back series before the Braves come to town Sept 14-16.

x_posts.label: Post 5A
x_posts.text:
Wrigley Field. Three games. Pittsburgh Pirates.

The Cubs just got swept on the road. Now they come home against a below-.500 club with the Braves coming in behind them.

This is not the time to coast. First pitch tomorrow, 1:20 PM CT.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW
